summary: Side-by-side UTV rolled at a dead end above the Chicago Tunnel in Imogene Basin; the driver rode the cart-wheeling vehicle about 500 feet down a 45-degree slope and did not survive. OCEMS treated the injured wife; OMRT packaged the deceased and transported the body to Camp Bird Mine.
